description: This file contains functions and types for processing Microsoft Teams messages, including HTML stripping, team ID resolution, message fetching, and thread formatting.

methods.name: stripHtmlFromTeamsMessage
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from Teams message content while preserving @mention display names.

methods.name: resolveTeamGroupId
methods.description: Resolves and caches the Azure AD group GUID for a Teams conversation ID.

methods.name: fetchChannelMessage
methods.description: Fetches a single channel message (the root of a thread) from Teams.

methods.name: fetchThreadReplies
methods.description: Fetches replies to a channel message, limited to 50, ordered chronologically.

methods.name: formatThreadContext
methods.description: Formats a list of thread messages into a string for context, skipping the current message and blank messages.
